Overlap or complement: Browser observes use; IdP/HR owns identity/account authority
Correlation keys: tenant, personaId, provider account ID, email weakly
Authority rule: External authoritative source owns person/account lifecycle
Conflict handling: Keep both observations; do not merge solely on email

Overlap or complement: Browser provides heartbeat use; endpoint/MDM owns device inventory/health
Correlation keys: tenant, assigned device ID, hardware token
Authority rule: MDM/endpoint should own canonical device identity

Overlap or complement: Browser is direct for active extension context; endpoint may inventory installed browsers
Correlation keys: device ID, browser product, profile instance ID
Authority rule: Browser sensor owns observed profile activity; endpoint owns host software inventory

Overlap or complement: Browser sees interaction; connector sees server-side tenancy/data
Correlation keys: tenant, provider account ID, app domain, time
Authority rule: Neither source alone is global authority for use
Conflict handling: Correlate with confidence and preserve source

Overlap or complement: Browser sees UI and unsupported direct traffic; gateway sees proxied API
Correlation keys: user/account, app/model, time, content hash if allowed
Authority rule: Do not double count; gateway authoritative for proxied request delivery, browser for UI action
Conflict handling: Dedup by explicit request/correlation ID preferred

Overlap or complement: Heartbeat observes runtime; deployment source owns expected installations
Conflict handling: Coverage finding needs both expected and observed
